No clean segment covers this objective. The video teaches HTTP connection closure and recycling, not bounded FastAPI/Uvicorn process termination or shutdown verification. The explanation at 306–366 mentions finishing existing requests and stopping further requests, but does not establish that terminating processes stop accepting new connections, allow background tasks to finish, or enforce configured time limits (f1). No clean standalone segment supports the verification objective. At 106–134 seconds, the video discusses stopping new connections and bounded cleanup, but does not verify termination during an active request. At 341–356 seconds, it mentions Uvicorn's graceful-shutdown timeout but incorrectly describes it as allowing at most 10 seconds for shutdown overall; this timeout bounds waiting for remaining requests/tasks, not subsequent lifespan cleanup. The video also repeatedly makes a substantive technical error: at 79–102, 265–276, and 404–409 seconds it claims context-manager cleanup after yield automatically runs when startup fails.
